notes: Header row of eight quoted names: "Account Type","Account Number","Transaction Date","Cheque Number","Description 1","Description 2","CAD$","USD$". Data rows unquoted except the two descriptions; Description 2 padded with a trailing space and left empty (unquoted) for fees. M/D/YYYY with no leading zeros. One signed amount (money out negative) in CAD$ for a Canadian-dollar account, or in USD$ (CAD$ empty) for a US-dollar account; no thousands separator. Every data row ends with an extra empty field (nine fields under an eight-name header); a 2025 importer expected a trailing comma on the header too. All of the person's accounts come in one file, one block per account, each oldest first. No balance. LF, ASCII, file named csvNNNNN.csv.
